property_summary: After calling owned(), the owner is unchanged
The owner address after calling owned() must equal the initial owner set during setUp.
After calling owned(), the owner remains the same as before the call.
After calling owned(), the owner address is the same as the owner of the contract after the last transferOwnership call with a non-zero address.
After a call to owned(), the owner address returned by the owner getter always equals the address stored after any prior transferOwnership call that was made by the current owner.
owned() is callable only by the current owner; after a non-owner calls owned(), owner remains unchanged.
After any call to onlyOwner-guarded functions, the owner remains unchanged unless transferOwnership is called.
After calling the onlyOwner-guarded function `owned()`, the owner address remains unchanged if no `transferOwnership` was called.
After calling the onlyOwner-guarded function owned(), the owner address is always equal to the contract deployer address (the initial owner) and never changes.
For any address, after calling owned(), the owner address of the contract remains the same as before the call.
After calling the onlyOwner-guarded function `owned()`, the owner address remains unchanged from its previous value.
